blocking_methods.label: tollFree
blocking_methods.instructions: Call 1800-209-0209 and follow the IVR to hotlist the card.

blocking_methods.label: alternate
blocking_methods.instructions: Call 0141-663-4000 and follow the IVR to hotlist the card.
Email customercare@aubank.in from your registered email to request card blocking.
Log in to internet banking at https://www.aubank.in and use the card block/hotlist option.
Block via the bank's mobile app (Cards > Block/Hotlist). Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.aubank.mobile | iOS: https://apps.apple.com/in/app/au-bank/id1050017613
